hard_exclusions.label: Severe layover or unsupported motion geometry

factors.label: Radar coherence
factors.explanation: How consistently the radar phase is preserved between acquisitions.

factors.label: Valid pair coverage
factors.explanation: The share of expected snow-free radar pairs that passed screening.

factors.label: Reference stability
factors.explanation: Whether the comparison ground remains internally consistent through time.

factors.label: Temporal consistency
factors.explanation: Whether overlapping radar pairs tell a compatible motion story.

factors.label: Correction burden
factors.explanation: Large applied corrections reduce confidence that a small residual is true motion.

factors.label: Independent radar agreement
factors.explanation: Agreement with Sentinel-1 where dates and footprints overlap.

factors.label: Permafrost context
factors.explanation: A coarse map prior, not proof of ground ice at an individual radar pixel.

factors.label: Thaw-season timing
factors.explanation: Accumulated summer warmth makes thaw-season movement more plausible, but does not prove its cause.

factors.label: Between-year persistence
factors.explanation: Whether sinking remains at comparable seasonal endpoints rather than rebounding.

factors.label: Ground-ice or fire context
factors.source_dataset: Alaska permafrost maps / AICC fire perimeters
factors.explanation: Mapped ground ice or a known disturbance can support, but not determine, interpretation.

factors.label: Field evidence agreement
factors.explanation: Independent field evidence is used only where its date and footprint are comparable.

factors.label: Recent-rain check
factors.explanation: Recent rain can mimic or complicate radar surface changes, so more rain lowers interpretation support.
